about_the_game:
LateMingFlyGuy is a platformer game.During the Wanli era, the daughter of the Chief Grand Secretary inexplicably ascends to the heavens. You will take on her role to defy gravity through flight techniques and aerial platforms, overcoming humanity"s lurking threats in the cosmos via collisions and other mechanics.

Operation Method：

Use the keyboard to control character movement.

Game Content:

Includes three different scenes and ten types of monsters that can be defeated.

Gameplay:

The game randomly generates floating platforms and obstacles. Players can choose to collide with and eliminate monsters or dodge them, while continuously challenging themselves to ascend higher.

Music Material：

Music provided by [Crow Producer]
